title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Government Debt & Infrastructure Finance - Paraguay IFT

description.narrative: OTA is assisting in strengthening the institutional capacity of the Finance Ministry and other relevant agencies in the formulation, appraisal, structuring and negotiation of infrastructure projects using the Public-Private Partnership model. It is also providing TA for strengthening the Ministry's risk analysis capacity and developing procedures for the identification and management of contingent liabilities arising from these projects.
